cases.summary: Warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia secondary to chronic lymphocytic leukaemia. The anchor immune case: DAT positive for IgG and C3d, spherocytes on the film, and an extravascular biochemical signature.

summary_i18n.nl: Warme auto-immuun hemolytische anemie bij CLL met IgG+C3d-positieve DAT en sferocytose - de immuun-referentiecasus.

cases.author: MedSimQA Editorial

presentation.chief_complaint: Three weeks of increasing breathlessness and dark urine, with jaundice noticed by his daughter two days ago.

chief_complaint_i18n.en: Three weeks of breathlessness and dark urine, with jaundice noticed two days ago.
chief_complaint_i18n.de: Seit drei Wochen Atemnot und dunkler Urin, seit zwei Tagen Gelbsucht bemerkt.
chief_complaint_i18n.es: Tres semanas de disnea y orina oscura, con ictericia advertida hace dos días.
chief_complaint_i18n.nl: Drie weken kortademigheid en donkere urine, sinds twee dagen geelzucht opgemerkt.
chief_complaint_i18n.ru: Три недели одышки и тёмной мочи, желтуха замечена два дня назад.

presentation.history_of_present_illness: Breathlessness on climbing one flight of stairs, progressing to breathlessness at rest over 72 hours. Urine has been the colour of strong tea, worst in the mornings. He has felt cold-intolerant and profoundly fatigued. No melaena, no haematuria, no recent travel, no new drugs, no fava beans. He was diagnosed with Rai stage 0 chronic lymphocytic leukaemia three years ago and has been on watchful waiting with a stable lymphocyte count of 22-28 x10^9/L.
past_medical_history: Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia, Rai stage 0, on watch and wait
presentation.social_history: Ex-smoker, 20 pack-years, stopped 15 years ago. No alcohol. Lives alone.

review_of_systems.general: Profound fatigue, night sweats for two weeks, no weight loss
review_of_systems.cardiovascular: Exertional then rest dyspnoea, palpitations, no chest pain
review_of_systems.genitourinary: Dark urine, no dysuria, no frank haematuria

examination_findings: Splenomegaly 4 cm below the left costal margin
Bilateral cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy, largest node 2 cm, rubbery and non-tender
Tachycardia 112 bpm with a soft ejection systolic flow murmur
No purpura, no petechiae, no bruising
No leg ulcers, no acrocyanosis, no livedo

results.interference_note: Raised by the reticulocytosis, not by B12 or folate deficiency - reticulocytes are roughly 20% larger than mature red cells.
Raised by spherocytosis: a sphere has less surface area per unit volume, so the cell is denser. MCHC >360 g/L has a short differential.
The absolute count is what matters. 286 x10^9/L is a vigorous regenerative response and effectively excludes a pure production failure.
Stable relative to his known CLL; this has not transformed.
Normal platelets argue against Evans syndrome and against a microangiopathy, in which the count would be low.

lab_panels.comment: The four-test screen: LDH, haptoglobin, unconjugated bilirubin, reticulocytes.

results.interference_note: Undetectable. Note that haptoglobin is an acute-phase protein, so a normal value during inflammation would NOT have excluded haemolysis.
Predominantly unconjugated, as expected when the bilirubin load exceeds hepatic conjugating capacity.

Only mildly raised. The pattern here is predominantly EXTRAVASCULAR (splenic macrophage clearance of IgG-coated cells); a large free haemoglobin rise would have suggested intravascular destruction instead.
Negative, consistent with extravascular haemolysis. It takes about a week of intravascular haemolysis to become positive, so a negative result early does not exclude it.
This, not haemoglobinuria, is what makes the urine dark in extravascular haemolysis - a distinction worth making explicitly to the patient.

lab_panels.comment: The tests that establish the immune mechanism.

results.interference_note: Strong IgG coating. IgG-coated cells are cleared by splenic macrophages, which partially remove membrane and generate spherocytes.
IgG plus C3d is the classic warm AIHA pattern. C3d alone would point to cold agglutinin disease instead.

results.value_text: Panagglutinin reactive with all panel cells; no underlying alloantibody demonstrable
results.interference_note: A panreactive eluate is characteristic of a warm autoantibody and is what makes crossmatching difficult.
Defines this as a WARM autoantibody. This single test separates warm AIHA from cold agglutinin disease.

lab_panels.comment: Roughly half of warm AIHA is secondary. Not looking is the commonest error in this diagnosis.

results.value_text: CD5+ CD19+ CD23+ kappa-restricted B-cell population, 22 x10^9/L; Matutes score 5/5
results.interference_note: Confirms the known CLL as the underlying driver, which changes treatment: rituximab-containing therapy addresses both.

results.value_text: IgG 5.2 g/L (low), IgA 0.6 g/L (low), IgM 0.3 g/L (low)
results.interference_note: Hypogammaglobulinaemia from the CLL. Relevant to infection risk before starting immunosuppression.

lab_panels.comment: Four weeks on prednisolone plus rituximab; steroid taper commencing.

results.interference_note: Recovering. Haptoglobin is the last haemolysis marker to normalise and is the most sensitive marker of ongoing low-grade destruction.

lab_panels.comment: Three months; prednisolone 10 mg daily and tapering.

red_cell_morphology: Numerous spherocytes (approximately 25-30% of red cells): densely staining, smaller than normal, with complete loss of central pallor
Marked polychromasia corresponding to the reticulocytosis
Occasional nucleated red cells (3 per 100 white cells)
Anisopoikilocytosis with occasional red cell fragments (<1%, well below the microangiopathy threshold)
Erythrophagocytosis by occasional monocytes - uncommon but, when present, strongly supports immune destruction
No agglutination at room temperature
No bite cells, no blister cells, no Heinz bodies on supravital staining
No sickle forms, no target cells, no basophilic stippling
white_cell_morphology: Absolute lymphocytosis of small mature lymphocytes with condensed 'soccer-ball' chromatin and scanty cytoplasm
Numerous smear (smudge) cells, characteristic of CLL
Neutrophils morphologically normal, no hypersegmentation, no toxic granulation
platelet_morphology: Adequate in number and normal in morphology
No platelet clumping, no giant platelets
smears.narrative: The film shows a florid regenerative anaemia. The dominant abnormality is spherocytosis with marked polychromasia and nucleated red cells, the morphological footprint of antibody-coated cells having membrane stripped by splenic macrophages. Occasional erythrophagocytosis is seen. Red cell fragments are present at well under 1%, far below the threshold that would raise microangiopathy. The white cells show the mature lymphocytosis and smear cells of the patient's known CLL. Taken with a DAT positive for IgG and C3d, the appearances are those of warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia secondary to a lymphoproliferative disorder. Note that spherocytes are NOT specific for immune haemolysis - hereditary spherocytosis produces an identical red cell picture, and the DAT is what separates them.

narrative_i18n.en: Florid regenerative anaemia with 25-30% spherocytes, marked polychromasia, nucleated red cells and occasional erythrophagocytosis; fragments <1%. CLL lymphocytosis with smear cells. With an IgG+C3d DAT the picture is warm AIHA secondary to a lymphoproliferative disorder.
narrative_i18n.de: Ausgeprägte regenerative Anämie mit 25-30% Sphärozyten, deutlicher Polychromasie, kernhaltigen Erythrozyten und vereinzelter Erythrophagozytose; Fragmente <1%. CLL-Lymphozytose mit Gumprecht-Kernschatten. Mit IgG+C3d-positivem DAT entspricht das Bild einer warmen AIHA bei lymphoproliferativer Erkrankung.
narrative_i18n.es: Anemia regenerativa florida con 25-30% de esferocitos, policromasia marcada, eritroblastos y eritrofagocitosis ocasional; fragmentos <1%. Linfocitosis de LLC con sombras de Gumprecht. Con PAD IgG+C3d el cuadro corresponde a AHAI caliente secundaria a síndrome linfoproliferativo.
narrative_i18n.nl: Uitgesproken regeneratieve anemie met 25-30% sferocyten, duidelijke polychromasie, kernhoudende erytrocyten en incidentele erytrofagocytose; fragmenten <1%. CLL-lymfocytose met smudge cells. Met IgG+C3d-positieve DAT past dit bij warme AIHA bij een lymfoproliferatieve aandoening.
narrative_i18n.ru: Выраженная регенераторная анемия: 25-30% сфероцитов, значительная полихромазия, нормобласты, единичный эритрофагоцитоз; фрагменты <1%. Лимфоцитоз при ХЛЛ с тенями Гумпрехта. При положительной пробе Кумбса (IgG+C3d) картина соответствует тёплой АИГА на фоне лимфопролиферативного заболевания.

red_cell_morphology: Occasional spherocytes only (<5%)
Mild polychromasia
No nucleated red cells
No erythrophagocytosis
No fragments
white_cell_morphology: Persistent mature lymphocytosis with smear cells, unchanged from baseline
smears.narrative: Substantial morphological resolution at three months. Spherocytes are now occasional and polychromasia mild, matching the biochemical recovery. The CLL lymphocytosis is unchanged, as expected: the haemolysis has been treated, the underlying clone has not been eradicated.

narrative_i18n.en: Substantial resolution: occasional spherocytes and mild polychromasia only. CLL lymphocytosis unchanged.
narrative_i18n.de: Weitgehende Rückbildung: nur noch vereinzelte Sphärozyten und milde Polychromasie. CLL-Lymphozytose unverändert.
narrative_i18n.es: Resolución sustancial: solo esferocitos ocasionales y policromasia leve. Linfocitosis de LLC sin cambios.
narrative_i18n.nl: Grotendeels hersteld: slechts incidentele sferocyten en milde polychromasie. CLL-lymfocytose ongewijzigd.
narrative_i18n.ru: Существенное разрешение: лишь единичные сфероциты и лёгкая полихромазия. Лимфоцитоз при ХЛЛ без изменений.

imaging.modality: CT thorax, abdomen and pelvis with contrast
imaging.findings: Splenomegaly 17 cm. Widespread lymphadenopathy: largest para-aortic node 2.4 cm. No mass lesion, no organ infiltration, no evidence of Richter transformation.
imaging.impression: Stable CLL with splenomegaly. No transformation. The spleen is the site of red cell destruction and its size explains the extravascular pattern.

protocols.name: Corticosteroid with rituximab for warm AIHA secondary to CLL

name_i18n.en: Corticosteroid with rituximab for warm AIHA secondary to CLL
name_i18n.de: Kortikosteroid plus Rituximab bei warmer AIHA bei CLL
name_i18n.es: Corticoide con rituximab para AHAI caliente secundaria a LLC
name_i18n.nl: Corticosteroïd met rituximab bij warme AIHA bij CLL
name_i18n.ru: Кортикостероид с ритуксимабом при тёплой АИГА на фоне ХЛЛ

protocols.guideline_source: Composite of BSH 2017 warm AIHA guidance and the First International Consensus on AIHA (2020), adapted
protocols.indication: Symptomatic warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia with haemoglobin 62 g/L secondary to chronic lymphocytic leukaemia.

regimen.notes: Expect a haemoglobin response within 1-3 weeks. Taper slowly over 3-6 months; abrupt withdrawal is the commonest cause of relapse.
Added early because the AIHA is CLL-associated. Early rituximab improves durable response and lets the steroid be tapered faster.
Sustained erythropoiesis consumes folate; deficiency will blunt the reticulocyte response.
Active AIHA carries a materially raised venous thromboembolism risk that is routinely overlooked.

regimen.dose: calcium/vitamin D plus a proton pump inhibitor
regimen.notes: Plus co-trimoxazole prophylaxis given hypogammaglobulinaemia and planned prolonged steroid.

regimen.dose: 1 unit at a time, ABO/RhD and phenotype matched as far as possible
regimen.notes: Do NOT withhold transfusion from a symptomatic patient because the crossmatch is incompatible. Discuss with the transfusion laboratory, use the least incompatible unit, transfuse slowly with observation, and document the decision.

monitoring: Daily FBC and reticulocytes until the haemoglobin is rising, then weekly
Haptoglobin and LDH weekly - haptoglobin is the last to normalise and the most sensitive marker of ongoing haemolysis
Capillary glucose while on high-dose steroid
Hepatitis B core antibody and surface antigen BEFORE rituximab: reactivation is a fatal complication and screening is mandatory
Repeat DAT is NOT needed for monitoring - it can remain positive long after the haemolysis stops
contraindications: Live vaccines during and for 6 months after rituximab
adverse_effects: Steroid: hyperglycaemia, osteoporosis, gastric ulceration, mood disturbance, infection
Rituximab: infusion reactions, hypogammaglobulinaemia, hepatitis B reactivation, rare PML
Splenectomy (if needed later): lifelong encapsulated organism risk, requires vaccination and prophylaxis
protocols.notes: Transfusion in warm AIHA is frequently and wrongly delayed. The autoantibody is panreactive, so no unit will be fully compatible; the risk of transfusing the least incompatible unit is far smaller than the risk of leaving a patient with a haemoglobin of 62 g/L and rest dyspnoea untransfused.

diagnoses.label: Warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia secondary to chronic lymphocytic leukaemia

label_i18n.en: Warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia secondary to chronic lymphocytic leukaemia
label_i18n.de: Warme autoimmunhämolytische Anämie bei chronischer lymphatischer Leukämie
label_i18n.es: Anemia hemolítica autoinmune caliente secundaria a leucemia linfocítica crónica
label_i18n.nl: Warme auto-immuun hemolytische anemie bij chronische lymfatische leukemie
label_i18n.ru: Тёплая аутоиммунная гемолитическая анемия на фоне хронического лимфолейкоза

diagnoses.discriminator: DAT positive for IgG and C3d with a panreactive eluate and a thermal amplitude reactive at 37 °C, spherocytes on the film, and an identified lymphoproliferative driver.
supporting_evidence: Haemoglobin 62 g/L with an absolute reticulocyte count of 286 x10^9/L
LDH 684 U/L, haptoglobin undetectable, unconjugated bilirubin 58 µmol/L
DAT IgG 4+ and C3d 2+ with a panreactive eluate
Autoantibody reactive at 37 °C, not at 4 °C
25-30% spherocytes with erythrophagocytosis on the film
CD5+CD19+CD23+ clone on flow cytometry (Matutes 5/5)
Response to prednisolone and rituximab

diagnoses.label: Cold agglutinin disease
diagnoses.discriminator: The DAT is positive for IgG as well as C3d, the thermal amplitude is at 37 °C, the cold agglutinin titre is only 16, and there is no agglutination on the film or acrocyanosis.
refuting_evidence: No red cell agglutination on the film

diagnoses.label: Hereditary spherocytosis
diagnoses.discriminator: Produces an identical red cell film. The DAT is what separates them, and it is negative in hereditary spherocytosis. Age 68 at first presentation and the absence of family history also argue against it.
supporting_evidence: Spherocytes with a raised MCHC
refuting_evidence: No prior history of gallstones in youth or childhood jaundice

diagnoses.label: Evans syndrome
diagnoses.discriminator: Requires concurrent immune thrombocytopenia. The platelet count is 218 x10^9/L.

diagnoses.label: Microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia
diagnoses.discriminator: Fragments are 0.6%, below any diagnostic threshold, platelets are normal, and the DAT is positive - a microangiopathy is DAT-negative by definition.

teaching_points: The DAT is the single test that separates immune from non-immune haemolysis, and its pattern subclassifies the immune causes: IgG with or without C3d indicates warm AIHA; C3d alone indicates cold agglutinin disease or paroxysmal cold haemoglobinuria.

Spherocytes are not specific for immune haemolysis. Hereditary spherocytosis produces an identical film, and the DAT is what distinguishes them - a negative DAT with spherocytes should prompt an EMA binding test, not reassurance.
The absolute reticulocyte count, not the percentage, defines a regenerative response. A percentage looks impressive against a low red cell mass while the absolute count may be inadequate.

Roughly half of warm AIHA is secondary - to lymphoproliferative disease, connective tissue disease, drugs, or infection. Failing to look for a cause is the commonest management error, and in this case finding the CLL changed the treatment.

Never withhold transfusion from a symptomatic patient because the crossmatch is incompatible. The autoantibody is panreactive, so no unit will be compatible; use the least incompatible unit, transfuse slowly, and document the reasoning.
Screen for hepatitis B before rituximab. Reactivation is a preventable cause of death.
Haptoglobin is an acute-phase protein. A normal haptoglobin during inflammation does not exclude haemolysis, and haptoglobin is the last marker to recover during treatment.
Active AIHA carries a substantially increased venous thromboembolism risk. Thromboprophylaxis belongs in the admission bundle.

references.citation: Hill QA et al. Guidelines on the management of drug-induced immune and secondary autoimmune haemolytic anaemia. Br J Haematol 2017.
Jager U et al. Diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune haemolytic anaemia in adults: recommendations from the First International Consensus Meeting. Blood Rev 2020.

reasoning_key.primary_diagnosis: Warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia secondary to CLL

must_include_findings.label: Positive direct antiglobulin test with IgG and C3d
Underlying CLL as a secondary cause

critical_values.reason: Severe symptomatic anaemia with rest dyspnoea

safety_rules.description: Must not advise withholding transfusion from a symptomatic patient purely because of an incompatible crossmatch.
Rituximab recommendations must mention hepatitis B screening.
Should search for a secondary cause.

cases.summary: Cold agglutinin disease. The case is built around a pre-analytical artefact - a spuriously high MCV and low red cell count that corrects when the sample is warmed to 37 °C - and a DAT positive for C3d alone.

summary_i18n.de: Kälteagglutininkrankheit mit durch Erwärmen korrigierbarem Analyser-Artefakt und ausschliesslich C3d-positivem DAT.

cases.author: MedSimQA Editorial

presentation.chief_complaint: Two winters of worsening fatigue with painful blue discolouration of the fingers, nose and ears on going outdoors.

chief_complaint_i18n.en: Two winters of worsening fatigue with painful blue discolouration of the fingers, nose and ears outdoors.
chief_complaint_i18n.de: Zwei Winter mit zunehmender Müdigkeit und schmerzhafter Blauverfärbung von Fingern, Nase und Ohren im Freien.
chief_complaint_i18n.es: Dos inviernos de fatiga creciente con coloración azulada dolorosa de dedos, nariz y orejas al salir al exterior.
chief_complaint_i18n.nl: Twee winters met toenemende vermoeidheid en pijnlijke blauwverkleuring van vingers, neus en oren buitenshuis.
chief_complaint_i18n.ru: Две зимы нарастающей утомляемости с болезненным посинением пальцев, носа и ушей на улице.

presentation.history_of_present_illness: Symptoms are strikingly seasonal: she is nearly well in summer and severely fatigued from November to March. Fingers and the tip of the nose turn dusky blue within minutes outdoors and ache on rewarming, without the classic triphasic white-blue-red change of Raynaud phenomenon. Her urine turns dark after being out in the cold. She has been told twice that her blood sample was 'clotted' and needed repeating - a clue that was not followed up. Two previous full blood counts were reported with an impossibly low red cell count alongside a near-normal haemoglobin.
past_medical_history: No known lymphoproliferative disorder at referral
presentation.social_history: Non-smoker. Lives in an old, poorly heated house. No recent travel.

review_of_systems.vascular: Acrocyanosis of fingers, nose, ears on cold exposure; no digital ulceration, no triphasic colour change

examination_findings: Acrocyanosis of the fingertips, nose and ear lobes in the cold clinic room, resolving on warming
No livedo reticularis, no vasculitic rash

lab_panels.panel_name: Full blood count - sample at room temperature
lab_panels.specimen: EDTA whole blood, transported at ambient temperature
lab_panels.comment: The artefactual result. These numbers are internally impossible and should stop the reporting process.

results.interference_note: Haemoglobin is measured after cell lysis and is therefore the ONE reliable parameter on this sample.
SPURIOUSLY LOW. Agglutinated clumps of red cells pass the aperture as single events, so the counter under-reports cell number.
SPURIOUSLY HIGH for the same reason: a doublet or triplet is sized as one very large cell.

A biologically IMPOSSIBLE value. MCHC cannot exceed about 370 g/L in vivo. An MCHC above 400 g/L means an artefact - cold agglutinins, lipaemia, or a haemolysed sample - and must never be reported without investigation.

lab_panels.panel_name: Full blood count - sample pre-warmed to 37 °C
lab_panels.specimen: EDTA whole blood, pre-warmed 30 minutes at 37 °C
lab_panels.analyser: Sysmex XN-9000 with warmed sample handling
lab_panels.comment: The same sample, warmed. This single manoeuvre both corrects the result and makes the diagnosis.

results.interference_note: Unchanged, as expected - it was never affected.
Nearly doubled on warming. The disaggregation of red cell clumps is the whole explanation.
Corrected into the reference interval.
Now physiologically plausible. The difference between the two panels is diagnostic in itself.

lab_panels.specimen: EDTA whole blood / serum, collected and transported at 37 °C
lab_panels.comment: Pre-warmed collection is essential: a cold-transported sample will have the antibody stripped onto the cells in vitro and give misleading results.

results.interference_note: IgG NEGATIVE. The IgM cold agglutinin dissociates from the cell at 37 °C, leaving only its complement footprint behind.
C3d ALONE is the diagnostic DAT pattern of cold agglutinin disease. This is the key discriminator from warm AIHA.
A titre of 1:64 or above with compatible clinical features is diagnostic; 1:4096 is unambiguous.

Thermal amplitude, not titre, determines clinical severity. Reactivity up to 32 °C means the antibody is active at the temperature of acral skin in winter - which is precisely the patient's symptom pattern.
Anti-I is typical of primary cold agglutinin disease and of Mycoplasma-associated disease; anti-i points towards infectious mononucleosis.
Substantially raised, reflecting a significant INTRAVASCULAR component - complement-mediated lysis, unlike the predominantly extravascular pattern of warm AIHA.
Positive haemosiderinuria confirms chronic intravascular haemolysis of at least a week's duration.
Consumed complement, consistent with ongoing complement activation on the red cell surface.

lab_panels.panel_name: Search for an underlying clone or infection
lab_panels.comment: Primary cold agglutinin disease is now recognised as a clonal lymphoproliferative disorder in most cases.

results.interference_note: A clonal IgM kappa is found in most cases of 'primary' cold agglutinin disease; the condition is best understood as a low-grade clonal marrow disorder rather than as idiopathic autoimmunity.
Its absence helps distinguish cold agglutinin disease from Waldenstrom macroglobulinaemia, in which it is present in over 90%.

lab_panels.comment: Four months after rituximab-bendamustine and with strict cold avoidance through the winter.

results.interference_note: Fallen but still positive. The titre lags the clinical response and should not be used alone to judge treatment success.

red_cell_morphology: Striking red cell agglutination in large irregular clumps, present from the feathered edge to the body of the film
Clumps are irregular and three-dimensional, NOT the linear stacked-coin arrangement of rouleaux - this distinction is the whole point of looking
Agglutination disperses completely when the film is prepared from a sample pre-warmed to 37 °C
Moderate polychromasia
Occasional spherocytes (<5%), far fewer than in warm AIHA
No fragments, no bite cells, no Heinz bodies
Occasional erythrophagocytosis by monocytes
white_cell_morphology: No lymphocytosis, no smear cells, no blasts
Occasional monocytes containing ingested red cells
smears.narrative: The dominant and immediately visible abnormality is gross red cell agglutination in irregular clumps, which disperses entirely on a warmed preparation. This is agglutination, not rouleaux: rouleaux form linear stacks and are associated with a raised plasma protein concentration, whereas these clumps are three-dimensional and temperature-dependent. Spherocytes are present but sparse, and polychromasia is moderate. There are no fragments and no oxidative changes. The agglutination is also the direct explanation for the impossible analyser indices on the unwarmed sample - a spuriously low red cell count, a spuriously high MCV and an MCHC of 442 g/L. Together with a DAT positive for C3d alone and a cold agglutinin titre of 1:4096, the appearances are diagnostic of cold agglutinin disease.

narrative_i18n.en: Gross irregular red cell agglutination dispersing on a warmed preparation - agglutination, not rouleaux. Sparse spherocytes, moderate polychromasia, no fragments. Explains the impossible analyser indices. With a C3d-only DAT and a 1:4096 titre this is cold agglutinin disease.
narrative_i18n.de: Ausgeprägte unregelmässige Erythrozytenagglutination, die sich im erwärmten Präparat auflöst - Agglutination, keine Geldrollenbildung. Wenige Sphärozyten, mässige Polychromasie, keine Fragmente. Erklärt die unplausiblen Analyser-Indizes. Mit ausschliesslich C3d-positivem DAT und Titer 1:4096 diagnostisch für eine Kälteagglutininkrankheit.
narrative_i18n.es: Aglutinación eritrocitaria irregular masiva que se dispersa en la preparación calentada: aglutinación, no formación de pilas de monedas. Esferocitos escasos, policromasia moderada, sin fragmentos. Explica los índices imposibles del analizador. Con PAD solo C3d y título 1:4096, es enfermedad por crioaglutininas.
narrative_i18n.nl: Grove onregelmatige erytrocytenagglutinatie die verdwijnt in een opgewarmd preparaat - agglutinatie, geen geldrolvorming. Weinig sferocyten, matige polychromasie, geen fragmenten. Verklaart de onmogelijke analyserindices. Met een uitsluitend C3d-positieve DAT en titer 1:4096 is dit koude-agglutinineziekte.
narrative_i18n.ru: Выраженная неправильная агглютинация эритроцитов, исчезающая в подогретом препарате, — именно агглютинация, а не монетные столбики. Единичные сфероциты, умеренная полихромазия, фрагментов нет. Объясняет невозможные индексы анализатора. При пробе Кумбса, положительной только по C3d, и титре 1:4096 — болезнь холодовых агглютининов.

imaging.findings: Spleen 13.5 cm. No lymphadenopathy, no mass lesion.
imaging.impression: Mild splenomegaly without nodal disease. Excludes an overt lymphoma driving the IgM paraprotein.

protocols.name: Cold avoidance with rituximab-bendamustine for cold agglutinin disease

name_i18n.en: Cold avoidance with rituximab-bendamustine for cold agglutinin disease
name_i18n.es: Evitación del frío con rituximab-bendamustina para la enfermedad por crioaglutininas
name_i18n.ru: Избегание холода с ритуксимабом и бендамустином при болезни холодовых агглютининов

protocols.guideline_source: Composite of international consensus on cold agglutinin disease (2020) and BSH guidance, adapted
protocols.indication: Symptomatic cold agglutinin disease with transfusion-independent but disabling seasonal anaemia and an IgM kappa clone.

regimen.notes: Not a soft recommendation: it is the single most effective intervention. Heated home, gloves, hat, scarf, warmed intravenous fluids, warmed blood products, and a warmed operating theatre if surgery is ever needed.
Targets the underlying clone. Response rates are around 50% as monotherapy and around 70-80% combined with bendamustine.
Added for a deeper and more durable response than rituximab alone.

Corticosteroids and splenectomy are largely INEFFECTIVE in cold agglutinin disease. Destruction is complement-mediated and occurs in the liver, not the spleen. This is the sharpest management difference from warm AIHA.

monitoring: Always request a pre-warmed sample for the full blood count; label the request 'cold agglutinins - warm at 37 °C' so the laboratory does not report an artefact
Haemoglobin, LDH and haptoglobin monthly during treatment
Cold agglutinin titre is a poor monitoring tool - it lags the clinical response
All blood products must be administered through a blood warmer
Warn the surgical and anaesthetic teams before any procedure involving hypothermia, particularly cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass
contraindications: Elective hypothermic cardiopulmonary bypass without haematology planning
adverse_effects: Bendamustine: myelosuppression, prolonged lymphopenia, infection risk
Rituximab: infusion reactions, hepatitis B reactivation, hypogammaglobulinaemia
protocols.notes: Complement inhibitors (for example sutimlimab, targeting C1s) are an option where available and are mechanistically elegant here, because they block the classical pathway that drives the destruction while leaving the antibody in place.

diagnoses.label: Primary cold agglutinin disease with an IgM kappa clone

label_i18n.en: Primary cold agglutinin disease with an IgM kappa clone
label_i18n.es: Enfermedad por crioaglutininas primaria con clon IgM kappa
label_i18n.ru: Первичная болезнь холодовых агглютининов с IgM-каппа-клоном

diagnoses.discriminator: DAT positive for C3d alone with a negative IgG, a cold agglutinin titre of 1:4096 with anti-I specificity, a thermal amplitude to 32 °C, and analyser indices that correct completely on warming.
supporting_evidence: Seasonal anaemia with acrocyanosis and cold-induced haemoglobinuria
MCHC 442 g/L - biologically impossible - correcting to 334 g/L on warming
Red cell count 1.42 correcting to 2.68 x10^12/L on warming
Gross agglutination on the film dispersing on a warmed preparation
DAT C3d 3+ with IgG negative
Cold agglutinin titre 1:4096, anti-I specificity, thermal amplitude 32 °C
Consumed C3 and C4 with raised plasma free haemoglobin and positive haemosiderinuria
IgM kappa paraprotein at 4.2 g/L

diagnoses.label: Warm autoimmune haemolytic anaemia
diagnoses.discriminator: DAT is IgG-negative and C3d-positive, the antibody is reactive in the cold rather than at 37 °C, spherocytes are sparse, and the destruction is substantially intravascular. Critically, the treatments differ: steroids work in warm AIHA and largely do not here.

diagnoses.label: Paroxysmal cold haemoglobinuria
diagnoses.discriminator: Also produces a C3d-only DAT and cold-induced haemolysis, but is caused by a biphasic IgG (Donath-Landsteiner) antibody, does not agglutinate red cells, and is typically an acute post-viral illness in children rather than a chronic seasonal disease in an older adult.
supporting_evidence: C3d-only DAT
Cold-induced haemoglobinuria
refuting_evidence: Chronic seasonal course in an elderly patient

diagnoses.label: Mycoplasma-associated cold agglutinin syndrome

label_i18n.es: Síndrome de crioaglutininas asociado a Mycoplasma
label_i18n.ru: Синдром холодовых агглютининов, ассоциированный с микоплазмой

diagnoses.discriminator: Also anti-I, but acute, post-infectious and self-limiting over weeks. Serology is negative here and the course is chronic over two winters.
supporting_evidence: Anti-I specificity

diagnoses.label: Rouleaux from a raised plasma protein

label_i18n.en: Rouleaux from a raised plasma protein
label_i18n.es: Formación de pilas de monedas por proteínas plasmáticas elevadas
label_i18n.ru: Монетные столбики при повышенном белке плазмы

diagnoses.discriminator: Rouleaux are linear stacks that do NOT disperse on warming and do not distort analyser indices in this way. The distinction is made by looking at the film, not by any additional test.
supporting_evidence: An IgM paraprotein is present
refuting_evidence: Paraprotein only 4.2 g/L - far too low to cause rouleaux of this degree

teaching_points: An MCHC above about 370 g/L is biologically impossible and always indicates an artefact: cold agglutinins, lipaemia, in vitro haemolysis, or a spherocytosis so severe it should be obvious on the film. Reporting it without investigation is a laboratory failure, not a patient result.
Warming the sample to 37 °C both corrects the count and makes the diagnosis. It costs thirty minutes and no reagent.

The DAT pattern subclassifies immune haemolysis: IgG with or without C3d means warm AIHA; C3d alone means cold agglutinin disease or paroxysmal cold haemoglobinuria. The IgM cold agglutinin elutes at 37 °C and leaves only complement behind.
Thermal amplitude, not titre, determines clinical severity. An antibody reactive up to 32 °C is active in acral skin on a cold day; one reactive only at 4 °C is a laboratory curiosity.
Steroids and splenectomy do not work in cold agglutinin disease. Destruction is complement-mediated and hepatic, not splenic - the single most important management difference from warm AIHA.
Agglutination is not rouleaux. Agglutination forms irregular three-dimensional clumps that disperse on warming; rouleaux form linear stacks and reflect raised plasma proteins.

Every blood product must be given through a warmer, and the anaesthetic team must be warned before any procedure involving hypothermia. Cardiopulmonary bypass in unrecognised cold agglutinin disease can cause catastrophic intravascular haemolysis.

references.citation: Berentsen S et al. Cold agglutinin disease revisited: a multinational, observational study. Blood 2020.
Jager U et al. Diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune haemolytic anaemia in adults. Blood Rev 2020.

must_include_findings.label: Red cell agglutination on the film

expected_next_tests: direct antiglobulin test with monospecific reagents

safety_rules.description: Must recommend warming the sample and warming any transfused product.
Must not present corticosteroids or splenectomy as effective first-line therapy.
